subject: Concatenation expressions
notes: kb/Work PB1406 (w62k). cite.py --check 8.8.3.3 "If both literal-1 and literal-2 are specified and both are zero-length literals the value of the concatenation expression is a zero-length literal" -> OK. The refuter's DIVERGES: SPECIAL-NAMES folds passed no national table, so N"A" & HIGH-VALUE took U+00FF where GR10 (--check 12.3.7.4 "When specified as literals in the SPECIAL-NAMES paragraph, the figurative constants HIGH-VALUE and LOW-VALUE" -> OK) requires the native national extreme. Every Fold/ClassOf/FigurativeChar site now names a LiteralEnvironment (private ctor: Program / SpecialNames(nationalPhrase, sr11) / Unscoped), so STOP, INVOKE, the boolean channel, OPTIONS and the AS-phrase screens can no longer drop the national table.
